sn6.8:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno || || Atha kho Subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā Suddhavāso capaccekabrahmā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paccekadvārabāhaṃ nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu || || Atha kho Suddhāvāso. paccekabrahmā KatamodakaTissakaṃ bhikkhum ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn6.8:2.1: Appameyyam paminanto || ko dha vidvā vikappaye || appameyyaṃ pamāyinam || nivutam maññe akissavan ti ||
